QuestInfo.name: Awakening
QuestInfo.0: Time has passed since the fall and resurrection of Shinsoo, and the awakening of the Empress. Find Neinheart and catch up on what's been happening.
QuestInfo.1: Ereve is almost fully restored, but much has changed. The Empress aged into full adulthood. And Shinsoo has left, leaving the Empress alone. Go offer her your support.
QuestInfo.2: The Empress is anxious, as she considers her Awakening to be incomplete. But her resolve to protect Maple World has not wavered.
